thread.title: US Futures Drop as Trump Hints at Potential Military Strike in Syria

title: US Futures Drop as Trump Hints at Potential Military Strike in Syria
text:
US Futures Drop as Trump Hints at Potential Military Strike in Syria April 11, 2018, 08:12:25 AM EDT By MT Newswires, MT Newswires Shutterstock photo 
US stock futures dropped heavily on Wednesday after President Donald Trump signaled a possible military intervention in Syria. 
Buoyed by an escalation of Middle East tensions, oil prices edged up to near their 2014 highs, with the global benchmark Brent Crude up 0.87% and the US West Texas Intermediate up 1.02%. 
In economic data, at 8:30 am, consumer prices are expected to come in unchanged for March, according to Econoday, while at 2 pm, data are expected to show the US budget deficit narrowing to $186 billion in March from prior month's $215.2 billion. 
The Federal Open Market Committee will release the minutes from its latest policy meeting at 2 pm. 
In equities, shares of VirnetX Holding ( VHC ) were 37.8% higher pre-bell following news that a federal jury in Texas has ordered Apple ( AAPL ) to pay the security software company $502.6 million for patent infringement.
